Les charges fixes tombent chaque mois, q: Fixed costs come due every month whether or not your projects earn anything: salaries (paid on the 25th), your own pay, rent and premises costs, servers and services. Les revenus viennent des projets en lign: Revenue comes from live projects (subscriptions, sales, ads, commissions) and from cloud offers. A project only earns once launched, and its users arrive gradually: keep enough to last several months before it pays for itself.
